claims.explanation: Carmofur is a thymidylate synthase inhibitor (and acid ceramidase inhibitor) whose selectivity is best explained by nucleotide-synthesis dependency: lines with intact/amplified pyrimidine salvage and high TYMS expression are sensitized, while lines with loss of the folate/pyrimidine pathway or high salvage capacity are protected. The transcriptional signature (up CDKN1A, BAX, FAS; down CDC20, CCNB2, BIRC5) and similarity to methotrexate/raltitrexed/cytarabine support a thymidylate-synthase/DNA-synthesis mechanism rather than the SARS-CoV-2 Mpro off-target. TP53 mutation is common in both sensitive and resistant lines, so it is not a strong discriminator.
